notes.title: Evil Tonight - Release Date
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39210701/43d93dc592dab8651d73f3401e40e7bb99b22747.png

Hello, Everyone!

Evil Tonight is finally releasing on October 14th 2021, which is right around the corner and right on time for an early Halloween surprise! Please add the game to your WISHLIST and follow the project for announcements, as well as to make sure you don’t miss out on our launch discount!

The game will also be available on Nintendo Switch (Europe, Australia and Americas only).

That's all for now!

DYA GAMES

notes.title: Viviette Release Date: 18 October 2018
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Our upcoming new game, Viviette, now has an official release date:

18 October 2018

Well, that's next week, on Thursday!

Viviette is an exploration-puzzle game with touches of classic horror. We highly recommend avoiding any kind of spoliers before playing the game, so that you can enjoy the full experience your own way. We think the game is super immersive from start to end.

In adversity, you should persevere. But if you get stuck in the game, just ask for help in the project's discussions forum. We won't reply, but surely other players will do. We will only reply to bug reports or technical issues, though we think the game is bug free.

Meanwhile, adding it to your wishlist will help with visibility before launch:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/883070/Viviette/

Thanks for reading!

Alberto & Dani

notes.title: Update v1.6.6 - Portuguese and Chinese languages!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25567532/52083943475ff7574340d828e13a8f6b0948df8a.gif

Since v.1.6.0, we have been adding new stuff and adjusting this game. The most notorious additions in v1.6.6 are Portuguese and Chinese fan made translations. Portuguese localization by Ruffles and Chinese localization by MasterJutou. Big thanks!

Also, we have recently added a new window size mode: Stretch. Now, on non 16:9 screens, the game will stretch and cover all the screen (just in case you don't like black borders).

So, let's sum up the most important changes present in the current v1.6.6 (available for Windows, Mac and Linux):

- Portuguese language.
- Chinese language.
- New window size option: Stretch.
- New button for changing to Previous Weapon.
- Config your gamepad pressing SPACE on your keyboard.
- Faster cutscene pacing.
- Skip single phrases in cutscenes.
- Fixed bug that may freeze some computers on Exit.
- Performance improvements.
- Minor fixes.

Thanks for your support! If you finish and like this game, don't forget to write a review, because that helps more than you think!

Alberto & Dani
